summary: The diff shows significant backend migration and removal of blog/newsletter/pages functionality, but does not implement either of the two requested requirements. REQ-1 (Filter button matching Version 89 design and functionality) is missing entirely from the frontend changes. REQ-2 (restoring Version 89 product catalog data) is also missing - the migration file only transfers existing product data structure without restoring any specific Version 89 products.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a Filter button to the ProductGrid component that matches the design and functionality from Version 89
missing_requirements.reason: No Filter button was added to ProductGrid. The diff shows ProductGrid.tsx was modified but only mentions 'improved contrast on badges' and 'prominent filter UI with better visibility' in the summary. No actual Filter button implementation, Version 89 design reference, or filtering functionality was added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Restore the product catalog data from Version 89, including all products that were present in that version
missing_requirements.reason: No Version 89 product data was restored. The migration.mo file only defines data structure transfer from old to new actor format but contains no actual product data. The productCounter is set to 227 but no products are initialized or migrated from Version 89. No evidence of Version 89 product restoration exists in any file.

hallucinated_features.description: Removal of blog functionality across multiple components
hallucinated_features.reason: BlogManagement, BlogTeaser, BlogPostModal, and related components were modified to remove or disable blog features. This was not requested in the BuildRequest.
Newsletter management was removed and newsletter signup form made non-functional. This was not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Removal of site pages management functionality
hallucinated_features.reason: Site pages management was removed and replaced with static default content. This was not requested in the BuildRequest.
A complete migration module was added to transfer data between actor versions. This was not requested and goes beyond the scope of restoring Version 89 product data.
Custom authentication was removed in favor of Internet Identity. This was not requested in the BuildRequest.
